name: ms_abc_noncoprime_char0_v2
statement: {k : Type*} [Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (a b c : Polynomial k) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hsum : a + b + c = 0) : (a.natDegree = 0 ∧ b.natDegree = 0 ∧ c.natDegree = 0) ∨ max (max a.natDegree b.natDegree) c.natDegree < (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical a).natDegree + (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical b).natDegree + c.natDegree
closed: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (a b c : Polynomial k) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hsum : a + b + c = 0), (a.natDegree = 0 ∧ b.natDegree = 0 ∧ c.natDegree = 0) ∨ max (max a.natDegree b.natDegree) c.natDegree < (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical a).natDegree + (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical b).natDegree + c.natDegree
informal: Non-coprime Mason–Stothers in char 0: nonzero a+b+c=0 are all constant or max degree < deg rad(a) + deg rad(b) + deg(c).
original: Theorem 5. Let k be any field of characteristic zero, and a, b, c ∈ k[t] be nonzero polynomials satisfying a + b + c = 0. Then we either have a, b, c ∈ k or max{deg(a), deg(b), deg(c)} < deg(rad(a)) + deg(rad(b)) + deg(c).
